title: Billing Office Calculation Note: The Amount Invoiced for a Served Catering Order
content:
## 1. The figure

The amount invoiced for a catering order that has been served under a Corporate Catering Service Agreement is worked out from the value the delivery entry most recently recorded on the agreement carries.

## 2. The discount

That value is reduced once by the total discount rate, and the discount does not act a second time on any later step. The total discount rate is the standing discount rate recorded on the agreement. The result of that single reduction is the discounted food and beverage value.

The catering spend invoiced on the agreement is counted over the 3 months ending on the day the invoice is raised.

## 3. The service charge

The service charge is the percentage printed against the catering service level, applied to the discounted food and beverage value and never to the rush surcharge or the delivery charge.

## 4. The rush surcharge

The rush surcharge is worked out on the value the delivery entry carries rather than on the discounted food and beverage value, and an order carries no rush percentage.

## 5. The delivery charge

The delivery charge is the fee printed against the catering service level, raised once for the order.

## 6. The total

The amount invoiced is the discounted food and beverage value, then the service charge, then the rush surcharge, then the delivery charge, added in that order and rounded to two decimal places only at the end.

## 7. Worked illustration on hypothetical figures

Take a hypothetical order on an agreement whose delivery entry carries 2000.00 USD, whose standing discount rate recorded on the agreement is 4.5 per cent, and whose service level is printed with a service charge of 20.0 per cent and a delivery fee of 95.00 USD.

| Component | Hypothetical figure |
| --- | --- |
| Value the delivery entry carries | 2000.00 USD |
| Total discount rate | 4.5 per cent |
| Discounted food and beverage value | 1910.00 USD |
| Service charge on that value | 382.00 USD |
| Rush surcharge | 0.00 USD |
| Delivery charge | 95.00 USD |
| Amount invoiced | 2387.00 USD |

The discount acts once and only on the value the delivery entry carries, so the reduction is 90.00 USD; the service charge, the rush surcharge and the delivery charge are each left as they stand. The base the service charge is taken on is the discounted food and beverage value of 1910.00 USD, giving 382.00 USD, and the base the rush surcharge is taken on is the value the delivery entry carries. The four components are added in the order set out above and the sum is taken to two decimal places once, at the end.
